description: This file defines the 'ViewQuickedit' class, a subclass of 'ViewAjax', responsible for handling the quick edit view in the SuiteCRM (a SugarCRM fork) application. It manages the loading of metadata, rendering of edit views, and handling of related business logic for quick editing records within the CRM interface.

classes.name: ViewQuickedit
classes.description: Handles the quick edit view rendering and logic in SuiteCRM, including metadata loading, view setup, permission checks, and dynamic rendering based on context.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the environment before rendering the view, including loading the related bean and setting flags.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method that renders the quick edit view, handling metadata source files, permission checks, and output formatting.

methods.name: getEditView
methods.description: Instantiates and returns an 'EditView' object used for rendering forms.
